column1: # ZAP rules whose Medium or High findings may merge anyway. Read by gate.jq.
# One rule per line: the ZAP plugin id, a tab, and why it is accepted -- a
# false positive, or a risk the team has decided to carry. A line without a
# reason fails the gate. Fixing the finding is preferred; an entry here
# accepts every future instance of that rule, not just today's.
